subject.title: [Bug]: When openclaw sends a link with an underscore to Feishu, the full hyperlink cannot be displayed

question: Should maintainers sponsor a fresh same-repository Feishu URL-boundary fix, or adopt/refresh one of the existing fork or closed-PR candidates?
rationale: The bug is valid and narrow, but existing `clawsweeper:no-new-fix-pr` state plus conflicting or closed candidates makes another automatic duplicate branch the wrong next step without maintainer direction.

options.title: Sponsor a fresh same-repo fix
options.body: Open one narrow Feishu plugin fix using the closed PRs as context, with regression tests and live Feishu proof before merge.

options.title: Adopt a candidate branch
options.body: Choose one existing candidate, resolve conflicts and review blockers, then require real Feishu behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Wait for contributor refresh
options.body: Keep this issue open without new automation until a contributor updates a candidate with mergeable code and proof.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a fresh same-repo fix
recommendation.body: Open one narrow Feishu plugin fix using the closed PRs as context, with regression tests and live Feishu proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu send-path maintenance makes this the strongest current owner signal for choosing the repair path.
